title: StellarMC
description: StellarMC is a whitelisted Minecraft vanilla survival server built by players, for players. Fair play, seasonal resets and a tight-knit community.
body:
# 🌌 Welcome to StellarMC!

**StellarMC** began in August 2023 as a small group of friends and has grown into a friendly, welcoming SMP built around community and fair play. If you're looking for a relaxed vanilla survival server without over-the-top gimmicks or pay-to-win features, you’ll probably like it here!

**🌿 Why StellarMC?**  
**Vanilla** - The classic Minecraft experience with a few quality-of-life additions  
**Community** – Friendly players who value cooperation and creativity  
**Whitelisted** – A safe, tight-knit environment  
**No Griefing** or **Cheating** – Fair play is strictly enforced  
Fresh Start **Every 12 Months** – Regular world resets keep things exciting and balanced  
**Java & Bedrock** Compatible – Play your way

**📌 Server Details**  
Hosted in Europe  
Version: **26.2**  
**Apply** & Join us on Discord: [https://discord.gg/Vh2GxnVSXR](https://discord.gg/Vh2GxnVSXR)

Server website: https://stellarmc.gg/
